targets.query: from(bucket: "fitness") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sleep" and r._field == "duration_s") |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 3600.0})) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "fitness") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sleep" and r._field == "score") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "fitness") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hrv" and (r._field == "last_night_avg" or r._field == "weekly_avg")) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
